historical_summaries.note: Archived evidence, kept byte for byte. The format identifier and the names inside these files are those of the implementation that produced the records.

linergen-final-evaluation.json.purpose: Sealed final test: 100 conditions x 5 paired seeds x 3 budgets for the four methods, with every per-cell value needed to recompute the paired contrasts, bootstrap intervals and Figure 6.

fem-transfer-audit.json.purpose: Synthetic FEM-transfer audit: reduced-order scorer vs four-corner FEM for the LinerGen-seeded CMA-ES winner on 20 new conditions, with every pair needed to recompute correlation, median error, bias and maximum error.

falcon9-vehicle.json.purpose: falcon9_2025_unblanketed_v2: selected design, initial FEM, CFD-corrected FEM, uncertainty bounds, failed checks and the formal verdicts. Intermediate CFD records are not included.

atlas-i-vehicle.json.purpose: atlas_i_14ft_representative_unblanketed: selected design, initial FEM, CFD-corrected FEM, uncertainty bounds, failed checks and the formal verdicts. Intermediate CFD records are not included.

figures-manifest.json.purpose: Every README figure: its SHA-256, the tool that drew it, and the private inputs it was drawn from (by hash).

checkpoint_manifest.purpose: Checkpoint file and weight hashes, architecture and configuration; the checkpoint itself is a GitHub release asset.

full_evidence_archive.contents: the 726 original frozen records (JSON / JSONL / Markdown), the three FEM / CFD visualization manifests named in figures-manifest.json, and SHA256SUMS.json

posthoc-followups.json.purpose: The three post-hoc vehicle follow-ups (docs/POST-HOC-FOLLOWUPS-REPORT.md): what each decided, with the values it decided on. Every earlier verdict is unchanged; these stages are reported beside them.

readme-figures.json.purpose: Every README figure and its SHA-256. The figures were drawn from the study records, most of them private; their drafting scripts are kept with the private records, so a public clone cannot redraw them.

posthoc_archive.contents: the private records named in posthoc-followups.json, and SHA256SUMS.json
